STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with an English muffin breakfast sandwich, fried/poached eggs with avocado and a bread roll, a cup of yogurt, a bowl of diced mango/papaya, and a glass of orange juice. Photographed from a fairly high frontal angle, roughly eye level with the tray.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The right-hand plate is about 22 cm across (side plate size), area ≈ 3.14 x 11² ≈ 380 cm². The left plate is about 17 cm, area ≈ 227 cm². The small bowl is about 9 cm across. The yogurt cup is about 7 cm across and 10 cm tall.

STEP 3 - Items:
- English muffin with sausage/egg patty (left plate)
- Fried egg whites and yolks, two eggs (right plate)
- Avocado slices (right plate)
- Bread roll piece (right plate)
- Mango/papaya cubes in small bowl
- Yogurt in cup
- Orange juice in glass (about 200 ml)

STEP 4 - Area (of the right plate, 380 cm²): eggs 25%, avocado 12%, bread roll 14%. Left plate (227 cm²): sandwich 60% of plate area. Bowl and cup are separate vessels.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Sandwich: ~95 cm² x 4 cm ≈ 380 ml (outer envelope, muffin + patty); use ~150 ml after bulk density is applied in step 6 as a dense item.
- Eggs: ~95 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 140 ml.
- Avocado: ~45 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 65 ml.
- Bread roll: ~55 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 165 ml.
- Mango/papaya: bowl ~64 cm² x 2.5 cm ≈ 160 ml, fill ~60%, so ~95 ml.
- Yogurt: ~150 ml (cup about 7 cm across, filled).
- Orange juice: ~200 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Sandwich: 150 ml x 0.9 ≈ 135 g
- Eggs: 140 ml x 0.95 ≈ 133 g
- Avocado: 65 ml x 0.7 ≈ 45 g
- Bread roll: 165 ml x 0.3 ≈ 50 g
- Mango/papaya: 95 ml x 0.6 ≈ 57 g
- Yogurt: 150 g
- Orange juice: 200 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Sandwich: 135 g x 250 kcal/100 g ≈ 338 kcal
- Eggs: 133 g x 155 ≈ 206 kcal
- Avocado: 45 g x 160 ≈ 72 kcal
- Bread roll: 50 g x 270 ≈ 135 kcal
- Mango/papaya: 57 g x 60 ≈ 34 kcal
- Yogurt: 150 g x 60 ≈ 90 kcal
- Orange juice: 200 g x 45 ≈ 90 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 770 g and ≈ 965 kcal. This is plausible for a full breakfast tray with two eggs, a breakfast sandwich, and a roll.
